english: Thus, upamäna is not a distinct proof, 305 The Mimamsakas join issue with the Naiyãyikas and hold that it is a truism that an individual cow is remembered by law of similarity when a gavaya is seen. english: 25-29. Obeisance to you, O lord of Pārvatī, O blue-throated great lord, O Śiva, O Rudra, O Mahādeva, O lord, obeisance to you, to Śaṃbhu.
